name: Dusky Goat
description: This goat appears no different from any other that lives in Teyvat — apart from its glowing markings and horns. Its coat is a lighter shade than that of the Chestnut Goat, but it, too, has two layers of hair, with the outer layer being long and waterproof, while the inner, milk-white layer is soft and fluffy, making it an ideal material for winter wear and woolen blankets. Long exposure to high-intensity kuuvahki environments has caused both its horns and the markings on its body to glow faintly.
